entries.odia: ମୁ ଖାଉଥାଏଁ ମୋହୋର ଭାତ; ତୋହୋର କିଆଁ ଗାଲରେ ହାତ!
entries.title: My meal, your troubled face
entries.literal_meaning: I am eating my own rice; why is your hand on your cheek?
entries.explanation: The speaker sets their own meal against someone else’s troubled pose. The dictionary explains that pose through distress. Our reading hears a pointed question about another person’s reaction: why should my ordinary act trouble you? It may sound teasing or defensive, but the line does not establish envy or explain the observer’s concern. That unanswered reason gives the exchange its edge.
entries.meaning_odia: କଥକ ନିଜ ଭାତ ଖାଇବା ସାମ୍ନାରେ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କ ଦୁଃଖୀ ଭଙ୍ଗୀ ରଖନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଗାଲରେ ହାତ ଦେବାକୁ ଦୁଃଖରେ ବୁଝାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ—ମୋର ସାଧାରଣ କାମ ତୁମକୁ କାହିଁକି ବ୍ୟଥିତ କରୁଛି? ଏଥିରେ ଟାହି ବା ନିଜକୁ ସମର୍ଥନ କରିବାର ସ୍ୱର ଥାଇପାରେ। କିନ୍ତୁ ଈର୍ଷା ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏନାହିଁ, ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ଚିନ୍ତାର କାରଣ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅକୁହା। ସେହି ଅକୁହା କାରଣରେ କଥାର ଧାର ରହେ।
entries.english_summary: A pointed question contrasts one person’s meal with another’s distress; the cause is unstated.
entries.odia_summary: ଜଣଙ୍କ ଭାତ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କ ଦୁଃଖର ବିରୋଧ; କାରଣ ଅକୁହା।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: At lunch, one friend eats while another rests a cheek in a hand. The eater playfully quotes the line. The friend replies that they are thinking about an unfinished letter. This invented reply shows why a troubled expression need not be envy.
entries.cultural_context: The source explains a gesture of affliction, not a universal body-language rule. No actual speaker, household incident or motive is documented.

entries.odia: ଯାହାଁ ଯାହାଁ ବୁଢ଼ା, ତାହଁ ତାହାଁ ବେକୁବ୍
entries.title: A verdict made from age
entries.literal_meaning: Wherever there are old people, there are fools.
entries.explanation: The repeated “wherever…there” makes age stand in for judgment. Our critical reading questions that shortcut: a person’s age cannot tell us whether a particular remark is foolish. The source preserves the insult, not this objection to it. Its sweeping rhythm can make the verdict sound settled before any individual has been heard.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁଠି ସେଇଠିର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ବୟସକୁ ବିଚାରର ସ୍ଥାନରେ ବସାଏ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ଏହି ସହଜ ରାୟକୁ ପଚାରେ—ବୟସରୁ କାହାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କଥା ନିର୍ବୋଧ କି ନୁହେଁ ଜଣାଯାଏନାହିଁ। ଉତ୍ସ ଅପମାନଟି ରଖିଛି, ତାହା ପ୍ରତି ଆମର ଆପତ୍ତି ନୁହେଁ। ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ କଥା ଶୁଣିବା ଆଗରୁ ହିଁ ଛନ୍ଦର ଜୋର ରାୟକୁ ସ୍ଥିର ଭଳି ଶୁଣାଇପାରେ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical reading challenges a sweeping insult that substitutes age for judgment.
entries.odia_summary: ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ କଥା ବଦଳରେ ବୟସରେ ରାୟ ଦେବାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପଚାରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: In a reading group, someone quotes the line after discussing a disagreement between generations. Another asks them to examine the disputed suggestion itself rather than the speaker’s age. This imagined response challenges the generalization; it is not a traditional reply supplied by the source.
entries.cultural_context: A documented age-directed taunt, not evidence about cognition or the beliefs of every community. Our rejection of its blanket judgment is explicitly editorial.
